title: Never changing his style; sincerity and a Pittsburgh jam session
summary: Armstrong says he never changed his way of playing and that sincerity matters. He criticizes youngsters showing off, citing a Pittsburgh jam session with nine saxophones.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
